talent.en: Everyone has at least one hidden talent.
talent.cn: 每个人都至少有一项隐藏才能。

sing.en: She can sing high notes very clearly.
sing.cn: 她能把高音唱得非常清亮。

dance.en: He dances on the stage every Friday night.
dance.cn: 他每周五晚在舞台上跳舞。

draw.en: He can draw a horse in less than a minute.
draw.cn: 他不到一分钟就能画出一匹马。

speak.en: My friend can speak three languages fluently.
speak.cn: 我朋友能流利说三种语言。

story.en: Grandma always tells the funniest bedtime stories.
story.cn: 奶奶总能讲最有趣的睡前故事。

stage.en: Stepping onto the stage made my heart beat fast.
stage.cn: 走上舞台让我心跳加速。

proud.en: I'm proud of my classmates for their great show.
proud.cn: 我为同学们出色的表演感到骄傲。
